prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: polished Open Graph social sharing card for Atlas, a documentation site for reusable coding-agent skills
Primary request: Create one minimalist, elegant, professional landscape card at exactly 1200x630 if supported; otherwise keep a cohesive 1.905:1 landscape ratio. Make the primary word dominant and instantly legible as a small link thumbnail.
Scene/backdrop: Flat warm-paper editorial composition with generous negative space and a very subtle paper grain.
Subject: Atlas brand card with a fine ledger rule and a tiny abstract chart route motif on the right, drawn in deep ocean and restrained verdigris.
Style/medium: Flat editorial graphic design, refined typography, understated and highly polished.
Composition/framing: Left-aligned typography on the left; keep every text element inside the central 85% safe area. Tiny route motif on the right. Generous breathing room.
Color palette: warm paper #e4d8c7, walnut ink #261b16, muted walnut #715b4d, deep ocean #173234, restrained verdigris #3f8580.
Materials/textures: Very subtle paper grain only.
Text (verbatim): Title “Atlas”; subtitle “Reusable skills for coding agents.”; small signature “Logbook for Devs”; small footer “atlas.logbookfordevs.com”.
Typography and placement: Confident Poppins-like sans-serif for the huge title. Literata-like reading serif for the subtitle. IBM Plex Mono-like small type for the footer domain. Preserve exact spelling, punctuation, capitalization, and legibility.
Constraints: Include only the specified text. Preserve all spelling. The standalone card needs only the specified copy.
Avoid: No illustration characters, mascot, ships, elaborate nautical scenery, UI screenshot, buttons, gradients, glow, excessive decoration, or extra text.
